record.question: Which country is famously known as 'Lady of Snow'?
record.explanation: Answer B: Canada. A Kerala Public Service Commission question bulletin’s country-nickname table explicitly lists “Lady of Snow — Canada.” This supports Canada (option (b), zero-based index 1) as the conventional epithet used in this exam context. Reference: https://www.keralapsc.gov.in/sites/default/files/inline-files/nov-01-2018.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
